jobs.occupation: Managing Consultant Global IT Vendor Management (m/f/d) (Global-Sourcing-Manager/in)
jobs.description: Introduction/About usGroup IT Strategy, Sourcing & Transformation shapes and supports the execution of the One IT vision across Fresenius. Conduct market analysis, benchmarking and commercial scenario modelling and prepare decision-ready business cases for the applicable approval bodies.- Third-party risk: Maintain a consolidated view of vendor-related risks and coordinate assessments, reporting and remediation with accountable functions such as Information Security, Data Protection, Compliance, Legal, Finance, Procurement and Business Continuity. Escalate material risks through the applicable governance channels.- Stakeholder relationships: Act as a primary commercial and governance interface between assigned strategic vendors and internal stakeholders. Facilitate cross-functional decisions, manage escalations and translate complex commercial, performance and risk matters into clear recommendations.Your qualifications- Substantial relevant experience in strategic IT vendor management, technology sourcing, contract and commercial management, procurement or a comparable supplier-governance role in a complex international organization.- Demonstrated experience managing complex and strategically important IT contracts or vendor portfolios, including commercial governance, service levels, contractual obligations, renewals, disputes and exit provisions.- Strong commercial and contractual expertise, including negotiation, benchmarking, business-case development, cost optimization and the application of contractual value levers.- Experience establishing and operating vendor-performance and governance frameworks, including scorecards, KPIs, SLAs, executive reviews, improvement plans and escalation processes.- A sound understanding of third-party risk management, including supplier due diligence, information security, data protection, compliance, financial risk and operational resilience.- Demonstrated ability to work effectively in a matrix organization, influence senior internal and supplier stakeholders, resolve complex escalations and facilitate decisions without relying on direct authority.- Strong analytical and communication skills, with the ability to interpret commercial, financial, performance and risk information and present clear recommendations to senior stakeholders.- Business-fluent English, required for global stakeholder and vendor engagement. jobs.description: To support our initiatives for further adoption of Philips technology providing Class IA guideline treatment options, we are expanding our International marketing team with a Business Marketing Manager DACH, responsible for the full IGTD product and solutions portfolio.The Business Marketing Manager is the dedicated field-based marketing owner for the DACH market zone, covering Germany, Austria and Switzerland.
